whoFor: Organisations that collect or use personal data and need to meet the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 (NDPA).

benefits.title: Know your position
benefits.text: A clear picture of how you handle personal data today.

benefits.title: Documents that fit
benefits.text: Policies and notices written for how you actually work.

benefits.title: Ready for questions
benefits.text: Records you can show customers, partners and the regulator.

whatYouReceive: A data protection review of how personal data is collected and used
Privacy notices and internal data protection policies
A gap list with priorities, and support with any filings the rules require
whatYouProvide: Information on the personal data you collect and the systems you use
A named contact for data protection
Access to the staff who handle personal data
doesNotInclude: Penetration testing or technical security audits
A promise of the regulator's view or decision
